children: Sleep hardware company Eight Sleep is gaining traction with a wider array of consumers and eyeing further opportunities to expand its market, UBS analysts say in a note. The company--which offers a sleep system capable of temperature regulation, sleep tracking, biometric monitoring and AI-driven health insights--is attracting more mainstream customers beyond athletes, biohackers, and technology enthusiasts, the analysts say. Management also sees opportunities to cater to the healthcare, diagnostics, hospitality industries as well as wellness centers, they say. Geographic expansion provides further runway, given international markets make up less than a third of revenue, they say. (kelly.cloonan@wsj.com)
